headline: Congress named a post office in Mount Vernon, Georgia after Second Lieutenant Patrick Palmer Calhoun.
what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 120 West Church Street in Mount Vernon, Georgia. The building will now be called the Second Lieutenant Patrick Palmer Calhoun Post Office. It does not change how the post office runs or what services it offers.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on May 7, 2024.
